# Anonymous editorial evaluation fixtures

These 24 Chinese fragments (12 development, 12 held out) and four semantic probes are
synthetic. They do not reproduce production passages or claim real model failures.
Run the identical task, context and candidate budget against both skill versions;
keep original text as the unchanged control. Evaluate factual/epistemic preservation,
necessary retention, requested edits, punctuation and reading preference separately.

No unique ideal rewrite is supplied. A shorter or lower-frequency result is not
inherently better. Keep generated outputs, blind label keys, production snapshots and
run reports outside the install package. After using the held-out set to tune a rule,
label it regression data rather than claiming it remains an unseen evaluation.
